newsitems.title: New Mode: Xeno Point
newsitems.author: haejun.yang
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0c0444b55cf737fa5c8229cf955a3208f9a38651.png"][/img]Mysterious threat has emerged in the once peaceful Miramar. An unidentified alien vessel, the “Construct,” has torn through the sky, unleashing unknown entities that now overrun the battleground. Join the all-new cooperative PvE mode, Xeno Point, now available in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, and fight to reclaim Miramar. You are the only ones who can stop this invasion. Prepare for battle with your team and make your way to the Mothership.[/p][p] [/p][h2]General Flow[/h2][p]Welcome to Xeno Point. Your mission is simple: Fight back against the enemy invading Miramar!
Reach the Mothership and defeat the Architect before time runs out. 
Go to Play > Arcade > Xeno Point to enter and start matchmaking.

[/p][h3]HUB[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/316597162fd8efe6218295392863a9cdb3b8eac5.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Each session begins in the HUB. Enter through the open doors and eliminate enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]After clearing the sector beyond the door, your team will return to the HUB.[/p][/*][*][p]On Normal difficulty, successfully returning to the HUB unlocks additional sectors that were previously unavailable. Decide as a team which sector to tackle next.[/p][/*][*][p]On Hard and Impossible difficulties, all doors, except for the Tier 4 boss sector, are open from the start.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Missions[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8dac82b99024f1793eea5b803289ad3e2253549e.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Complete a series of objectives while fighting waves of Xenos.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete missions to unlock sector doors. Missions become progressively harder across sectors.[/p][/*][*][p]When a player dies, all progress resets except for Supers, Blue Chip Skills, and unspent Fragments and Skill Points.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Work Together[/h3][list][*][p]The team can view each member's vital stats, equipment tier, Supers, and more. [/p][/*][*][p]Use this information to plan your strategy effectively. Share key items, equip different Supers within the team, and revive downed teammates.[/p][/*][*][p]Teammates can be revived at any time, but the team fails if all members are downed.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Craft and Upgrade Supers[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/680249413fff9edc002d5d0edc693ae96641aadc.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Supers are powerful abilities that recharge over time. Some Supers are stronger when used together. Coordinate with your team to discover powerful combinations. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5b58f38a0f59680bc7232949afde06c0960d63d1.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Players can craft and upgrade Supers using Fragments at the Crafting Station in HUB.[/p][/*][*][p]After completing a full set, Supers can be further upgraded. [/p][list][*][p]An available Super is selected at random when crafting or upgrading.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Purchase Blue Chip Skills[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d57177a353caf001c082d7d18743f78caa22d79d.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Blue Chip Skills provide stat boosts and combat bonuses. [/p][/*][*][p]Players can purchase and refund Blue Chip Skills using Skill points at the Crafting Station in HUB.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlike Supers, these skills can be refunded, allowing players to freely adjust their Skill Tree.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Difficulty[/h3][list][*][p]Difficulty is divided into three levels: Normal, Hard, and Impossible.[/p][/*][*][p]After defeating the boss on the previous difficulty, purchase the Difficulty Amplifier Skill to access higher difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]Higher difficulties increase the chance of obtaining higher-tier equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]All team members must purchase the Difficulty Amplifier to advance to the next difficulty.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Resources[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b54295081b66d15de68e9c30588c0557595c9b9a.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Kill enemies and complete missions to earn Skill Points, Fragments, and unique gear with extra abilities. [/p][list][*][p]The signature weapon of Xeno Point, the “Xeno Cannon,” deals significantly increased damage to enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]The Xeno Cannon is a powerful weapon that uses exclusive ammo. More ammo can be obtained from the Sector Commander and Fabricators.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Higher-tier equipment, including weapons, comes with unique perks. [/p][/*][*][p]Playing on higher-tier maps and difficulties rewards better loot.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Boss[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/39eb0c81dbbe3abfed94b8f4a6396ff493a8dcba.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The final objective of each sector. Defeat the powerful Sector Commander that appears at the end of the sector.[/p][/*][*][p]Each boss and enemy has a unique weakness. Work together with your team to use the right weapons and Supers, and strike when their weakness is exposed.[/p][/*][*][p]Your ultimate goal is to reach the boss sector, the Mothership, where you must defeat the Architect leading the invasion.  [/p][/*][/list][h2]Mode Settings[/h2][list][*][p]Map: Miramar[/p][/*][*][p]Perspective: TPP[/p][/*][*][p]4-Man Squads[/p][list][*][p]Teams consist of up to 4 players.[/p][/*][*][p]You can form a team in advance before starting matchmaking.[/p][list][*][p]Solo play is available, but matchmaking is not supported if your team is not full.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty is fixed to squad-level regardless of team size.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Teamkill is disabled.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Notes[/h2][list][*][p](PC) You can check your Total Score rankings (Fragments + Skill Points) and play records on the Bridge website under the “Ranking” tab.[/p][list][*][p]PUBG Bridge Link: [url="https://bridge.pubg.com/"]https://bridge.pubg.com/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Rankings and records will remain available on the website even after the Xeno Point mode ends.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Does not provide XP or gameplay rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Will not be reflected in your Match History.[/p][/*][*][p] Will not be reflected on the Career page.[/p][/*][*][p] Does not support replays. 
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Service Period (UTC)[/h2][list][*][p]PC : April 8, after live server maintenance - May 6, 07:00[/p][/*][*][p]Console : April 16,  after live server maintenance - May 14, 07:00 [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Event Pass: Xeno Point[/h2][p]Fight back the Xeno invasion! Defend the Battlegrounds, loot gear, and defeat enemies with the Event Pass: Xeno Point.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2af402c945f735444892af8d61d614dc4661fa04.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Items List[/h3][list][*][p]Event Pass: Xeno Point ($3.99)[/p][/*][*][p]1 Level (100 G-Coin) [/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3]Sales Period (UTC)[/h3][list][*][p]PC: April 8, after live server maintenance - May 6, 07:00[/p][/*][*][p]Console: April 16, after live server maintenance - May 14, 07:00 [/p][/*][/list][p]
Now, stop the invasion and survive until the very end.
See you in Xeno Point.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team[/p]

newsitems.title: PUBG Esports 2026 Roadmap – A New Era Begins
newsitems.author: [****] UZI
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="ii0m4BVFg1U;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A New Era Begins – PUBG Esports 2026[/p][p align="start"]Hey PUBG Esports fans,
We’re entering a new chapter. And it starts with a bold step forward.[/p][p][/p][h2]A New Beginning for PUBG Esports[/h2][p align="start"]Over the past seven years, PUBG Esports has grown through constant challenges.[/p][p align="start"]Now, as we move into 2026, we’re taking the next leap:
PUBG Esports will officially transition to Third-Person Perspective (TPP).[/p][p align="start"]This is not about replacing what came before — it’s about expanding what PUBG Esports can become.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why TPP? [/h2][p align="start"]PUBG has always been about strategy, tension, and survival — no matter the perspective.
But for most of the 1 billion players who’ve experienced PUBG, that experience has been through TPP.[/p][p align="start"]While FPP built the foundation of our professional scene, we also heard from fans and players that the gap between [i]playing PUBG[/i] and [i]watching PUBG Esports[/i] sometimes felt too wide.[/p][p align="start"]The move to TPP is about bringing the two experiences closer together — aligning what players love to play with what they love to watch.
It’s about making the game more accessible, relatable, and immersive for more people around the world — without losing the depth and skill that define our competition.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Built Through Conversations & Community[/h2][p align="start"]This change didn’t happen overnight.[/p][p align="start"]Over the past year, we’ve been in constant dialogue with teams and players, holding more than three official feedback sessions to share ideas, concerns, and direction.[/p][p align="start"]We also tested and verified our vision through the PUBG Players Tour (PPT), which saw over 5,000 unique competitors each season. These events proved that a TPP-based competitive scene can be both thrilling and sustainable.[/p][p align="start"]Your feedback — from pros to fans — has shaped every step of this transition.
And it will continue to shape how PUBG Esports grows from here.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]The 2026 Season – Global Expansion, Bigger Stage[/h2][p align="start"]With TPP as the new foundation, PUBG Esports 2026 will feature a more dynamic, globally connected structure — bringing more teams, more matches, and more stories than ever before.[/p][h3]Key Highlights:[/h3][list][*][p]PUBG Global Series (PGS) – [i]12 tournaments throughout the year[/i][/p][/*][*][p]PUBG Nations Cup (PNC) – [i]returns in late June[/i][/p][/*][*][p]PUBG Global Championship (PGC) – [i]crowns the world’s best in December[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Along with the expanded calendar, we’re increasing support funds and prize pools for both Global Partner Teams and qualified teams, reinforcing a more stable and sustainable esports ecosystem.[/p][p align="start"]From regional leagues to global championships, every part of the season will now feel like one connected journey — a year-long story shared by players and fans alike.[/p][p][/p][h2]Looking Ahead – A Future We Build Together[/h2][p align="start"]2026 marks the beginning of a new era for PUBG Esports.
The shift to TPP and the evolution of our competitive structure are not short-term changes — they’re the foundation for long-term growth and a thriving ecosystem.[/p][p align="start"]We’ll continue to listen, learn, and evolve — guided by player feedback, data, and our shared love for this game.[/p][p align="start"]Together with our fans, teams, and players, we’re writing the next chapter of PUBG Esports.
And we can’t wait for you to be part of it.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your passion, your criticism, and your belief in what PUBG Esports can become.[/p][p][/p][h1]A New Era Begins.[/h1][p align="start"]PUBG Esports 2026[/p]

newsitems.title: ENTERING ERANGEL: SUBZERO - The Cold is Coming
newsitems.author: haejun.yang
newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube=eFRcy0Bcqtc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Erangel: Subzero[/h1]
…Everything began with a twisted ambition to turn the Battlegrounds into something far more unforgiving.
During a clandestine experiment, a catastrophic failure sent multiple Tythonic Satellites crashing down onto Erangel. The impact ruptured the Satellites and released cryogenic gas, which soon spread across the island. The Blue Zone was not spared from its influence, and Erangel’s climate began to warp under the growing chill. The crash sites froze over, and the island soon found itself gripped by sudden, severe changes in weather.
Now, you must fight to survive in Erangel’s frigid and treacherous landscape—and remember that this marks only the beginning of a long and unforgiving winter..

[h2]Area Modifications
[/h2]Several areas across Erangel have changed following Satellite crashes.

[h3]Stalber[/h3]
Stalber, where magnetic field experiments were being conducted, has frozen over due to the cryogenic gas leaking from the crashed Satellite.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e39fcea017ee0611489fb494c9c0ef4902b72c93.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/74feb59904d5b265d8f8ecd52cc9975a7aa379d1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Shelter[/h3]
Shelter, once a hidden storage site for the Tythonic Satellites, now stands among the places where those Satellites have crashed back to earth. Rumor has it some of them hold valuable loot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a810058e82efbaf56838146e59e99abedcc14484.jpg[/img]

[h3]Sosnovka Military Base & Boatyard[/h3]
These two areas have also undergone drastic changes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b684c29ca130e639462080209866e31c43c8c6f7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Areas[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6d5414e62395af2379d79c3d58619e5a8110fab1.jpg[/img]
[*] The bridge leading to Sosnovka Military Base has partially collapsed following a Satellite crash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f07757f7138bd39081ce61c62e097e3a0f83f02b.jpg[/img]
[*] The southwestern plain of Erangel has also seen major changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4c54f174fc522818b87381746f754bb6b53ccb47.jpg[/img]
[*] Wreckage from crashed Satellites can be found in certain areas.
[*] Several rivers have frozen over due to the sharp drop in temperature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/014edc3266721d8494ebebeb1ac0f268f89493c2.jpg[/img]
[*] Snow piling up across Erangel has also altered parts of the terrain.
[/list]

[h2]Blue Zone[/h2]
[i]※ The following changes apply to all modes except Team Deathmatch.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/cdcbfe567c49a363b1f5ffaa374dcd9744f49bcc.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] A freezing effect has been added.
[*] The damage, speed, and radius of the Blue Zone remain unchanged.
[*] New visual and sound effects have been added, varying by the level of Blue Zone damage.
[*] The freezing effect is not blocked by the Jammer Pack.
[*] The above changes also apply to both the BZ Grenade and the BZ Grenade Launcher.
[/list]

[h2]BZ Grenade[/h2]
[list]
[*] A freezing effect has been added to the Blue Zone sphere generated upon throwing.
[*] This effect functions the same way as that of the Blue Zone.
[/list]

[h2]New Weapon: BZ Grenade Launcher[/h2]
Introducing a single-shot, break-open launcher found only in Erangel: Subzero. Use the BZ Grenade Launcher to pressure enemies or block their vision!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fe4537f157806e32411ac1f9cf76436f6e163a55.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Inventory slot: Secondary Weapons
[*] Ammo: 40mm BZ Grenade
[*] Ammo weight: 20
[*] When attached to a surface such as an object, the ground, wall, or roof, a Blue Zone sphere with a 7.5 m radius is created after a short delay.
[*] The sphere is less powerful than the one created by the BZ Grenade, dealing 8 damage per second.
[*] A warning sound plays before the sphere is generated.
[*] Does not activate when landing on water.
[*] 2-3 rounds spawn together with the BZ Grenade Launcher.
[*] Spawns in the World, Secret Rooms, and from Satellites.
[/list]

[h2]Weather[/h2]
Experience completely different weather conditions caused by the climate change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0d8ba05b2ebcb2294a852b48dcc3d535b1765543.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] A faint chill can be felt in the air, though the skies remain clear for now.
[*] Applies to Arcade only.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5f17276af60930b27d85f0273672ff125f400d77.jpg[/img]
[*] Snowflakes begin to fall, gradually covering the ground.
[*] With the Dynamic Weather feature enabled, changing winter conditions unfold across the Battlegrounds.
[*] Applies to Normal Match, Ranked, and Custom Match.
[/list]

[h2]Spawn Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Vikendi Ghillie Suit now spawns in Secret Rooms, Care Packages, and special airdrops.
[*] The world spawn rate of the M79 has been increased.
[*] The world spawn rates of the P1911, P92, and R1895 have been slightly reduced.
[/list]

[h2]Map[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8372346587cf957b67fb0d0f16bfe95aed0a975e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] The World Map and Minimap have been updated in alignment with the above changes.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Due to the aftermath of the Satellite crash, the Red Zone has been disabled.
[*] The rivers and sea have frozen, temporarily suspending ferry operations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7f39af53e16b2d4a9bd936ddf58b5ee937666ae8.jpg[/img]
[*] Airplanes operating over Erangel have received visual changes.
[*] When parachuting, visibility may be reduced due to changing weather conditions.
[/list]

[i]<Dev’s comment>
Update 39.1 brings a harsh winter to Erangel, PUBG’s most iconic battleground. The Blue Zone, now carrying a freezing effect, along with frozen rivers and terrain and shifting weather conditions, all demand quick decision-making and constant adaptation from players. Crossing frozen water to open new routes or engaging in firefights around snow-covered positions will introduce combat situations that feel entirely new. The new BZ Grenade Launcher also adds fresh tactical possibilities, allowing players to adapt their approach depending on the flow of battle. This update is more than a simple environmental change. It is designed to add tactical tension and bring variety to travel routes, key positions, and overall survival strategy across Erangel.
Erangel’s winter will only grow harsher as time goes on, and we hope you meet the challenge and forge your own path to victory in Erangel: Subzero.[/i]


Check out the [url=https://www.pubg.com/en/news/9466]39.1 Patch Notes[/url] for more details on other updated features and the [url=https://pubg.com/news/9467]Map Service Report - Update 39.1[/url] for the latest info on regional map preferences and rotations!
